subject: Re: Onsite operational plan — agenda stitch, presenter roles, and prework batching
messages:
From: Sara Conway <sara.conway@summitworks.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@summitworks.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onsite requirements + attendee roster (Dec 7–9 workshop)

Hi Naomi —

Thanks again for running point on the onsite. Quick summary from our side and a couple asks so we can align on the agenda and presenter plan: 

- Attendee profile: 28 product + engineering leaders, 6 exec sponsors.
- Constraint: three senior execs (arriving late evening Dec 6) want a 20-minute briefing before dinner on Dec 6.
- Goal: one provocation session (45m), two breakouts (60m each), synthesis + next steps (45m).

Could you share an initial agenda draft and recommended presenter assignments? Also attaching the roster (SummitWorks_Roster.xlsx) — a few people are locked to AM travel and need early sessions.

We'd like the pre-read packet to be one consolidated PDF (no more than 8 pages) split into: 1) context & goals, 2) data snapshot, 3) working questions. Can your team own the bundle and indicate a deck drop deadline?

Appreciate it — Sara

Attachments: SummitWorks_Roster.xlsx
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Conway <sara.conway@summitworks.com>
Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@summitworks.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite requirements + attendee roster (Dec 7–9 workshop)

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the roster and the clear asks. Draft agenda attached (RI-proposed-agenda-v1.pdf). High level:

- Day 0 (evening Dec 6): Exec briefing (20m) + reception — Naomi + Vivek to lead briefing.
- Day 1: Provocation (45m) -> Breakouts A/B (60m) -> Synthesis (45m).
- Day 2: Deep dives, partner Q&A, next steps.

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Confirm exec briefing owners — I'm proposing Naomi + Vivek for content and SummitWorks execs for alignment.
2) Presenter assignments for each breakout (name + slide owner).
3) Final deck drop for consolidated pre-read: Dec 30 COB PST so we can produce the single PDF and run prints.

Looping in Mateo and Vanessa — Mateo for presenter orchestration and logistics, Vanessa for deck packaging and printing run.

Naomi

Attachments: RI-proposed-agenda-v1.pdf

Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite requirements + attendee roster (Dec 7–9 workshop)

Thanks Naomi — quick pass from my side on presenters and timing:

- Exec briefing (Dec 6 eve): Naomi + Vivek (Naomi to handle narrative, Vivek will add slides on reliability benchmarks).
- Provocation session (Day 1 AM): Daniel Kim (SummitWorks) + Redwood research lead (TBD) as co-presenters — 45m (20m talk + 25m facilitated discussion).
- Breakout A (Product strategy): Lead - Priya Natarajan (internal) — deck owner: Priya.
- Breakout B (Ops/Serving): Lead - Karthik Iyer (internal) — deck owner: Karthik.
- Synthesis (Day 1 PM): Naomi to facilitate; Vanessa to produce the capture slide template.

Logistics notes: several SummitWorks participants flagged early flights on Day 1 — recommend scheduling the provocation at 10:00 rather than 09:00 to accommodate arrivals.

Action items assigned to me: collect headshots, confirm AV needs (mic counts + clicker), and maintain a presenter roster in the Drive folder. I'll upload a Presenter_Kit_Checklist.docx by EOD Friday.

-Mateo
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sara Conway <sara.conway@summitworks.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite requirements + attendee roster (Dec 7–9 workshop)

Great — smallest set of notes from packaging/print: 

- Deck drop deadline for all internal presenters: Dec 30 COB PST. External presenters (SummitWorks) should share final slides by Dec 28 to allow iteration.
- Pre-read bundle plan: Vanessa will accept separate slide PDFs and generate the single 8-page PDF. Please keep each slide deck to a max of 4 slides contributing to the pre-read.
- Print run: 40 copies + 10 extras. Confirmed vendor (PrintFirst) lead time requires final PDF by Jan 2 to guarantee on-site delivery.
- Presenter Kit: I will produce name badges, cue cards (one-sheet with 3 talking points), and a printed slide summary for each presenter.

On the topic of the provocation time shift: fine with 10:00. Mateo — please confirm speaker arrival windows so we can schedule rehearsals (short 10–15m run-throughs) the morning of Day 1.

Vanessa

Attachments: Presenter_Kit_Checklist.docx

Perfect — team, thank you. A few confirmations from our side: 

- We confirm the 10:00 provocation start and exec briefing at 19:15 on Dec 6.
- We'll get SummitWorks final slides to Vanessa by Dec 28.
- Travel note: two execs will now arrive on the morning of Dec 7 unexpectedly; they still want a 20-minute private read-ahead call at 18:45 on Dec 6 if possible. Naomi/Vivek — can you accommodate a 30m prep call at 17:30 Dec 6 instead of the 19:15 slot? If not, we can keep 19:15 for the reception and have a quick 20m briefing at 18:45.

One last request: can you confirm who will own the follow-up mutual action plan doc and the template so SummitWorks can review during the workshop?

Sara
